Example inputs used for the patterns
namePrefix = 'pcpro' (variable in main.bicep); container and deployment names are fixed strings
<unique> = uniqueString(resourceGroup().id): 13 characters, stable per resource group (example a1b2c3d4e5f6g)
<run> = 13 characters of uniqueString(resourceGroup().id, deploymentToken); new each deployment
Parsed 44 declarations; 16 skipped (role assignments, blob service, Microsoft Graph)
pi-events-stream (Eventstream) is published separately, not by the provisioner
Purposes ending in '· if ...' are off in the portal's default selection
Recommendation: <env> = dev, test or prod; <region> = short code such as weu
Left: names as main.bicep and the provisioner resolve them. Right: a recommendation with illustrative Cloud Adoption Framework names; the template does not deploy it.
